capabilities.name: date_states
capabilities.summary: Per-date states from the accepted cohort catalog
capabilities.reason: Each date inherits its acquisition window's state; dates with no delivered rows are ZERO, not missing.
qualifications: A zero-row date is not a survey non-observation.

capabilities.name: date_counts
capabilities.summary: Delivered alert rows per UTC date (complete)
capabilities.reason: Every delivered DIA and SSO DiaSource packet of the cohort, binned by the UTC date of midpointMjdTai.
qualifications: Delivered rows are not Rubin completeness and are never read as alert rates.

capabilities.name: transport_totals
capabilities.reason: Validated rows equal expected topic messages for every acquisition in the cohort.
qualifications: Transport totals are not Rubin completeness and must never be compared across windows as rates.

capabilities.name: density
capabilities.reason: Counts of demo-sample loci per equal-area cell.

capabilities.name: coverage
capabilities.reason: No survey footprint or exposure product is pinned for ANTARES in this basis. Locus density is not coverage, and empty cells are not zero-coverage cells.

capabilities.name: filtered_density
capabilities.reason: The entity table is the complete population of this basis.

capabilities.name: density
capabilities.reason: Counts of every derived DIA group in the cohort per equal-area cell.

capabilities.name: coverage
capabilities.reason: Fink Light Static delivers alerts, not survey pointings: the Rubin observing footprint is not in this basis. Cells with delivered DiaObjects are density, not coverage; an empty cell is not evidence that Rubin did not observe it.

capabilities.name: filtered_density
capabilities.reason: The Fink entity layer is a random sample; filtering it would present sample counts as population counts. Filters apply to sampled points only.

capabilities.name: inspector
capabilities.reason: Supported locus fields with per-field evidence.

capabilities.name: lightcurve
capabilities.reason: Only synthetic demo stories exist (10 loci); they are not ANTARES alert photometry.

capabilities.name: broker_inference
capabilities.reason: Filter-pipeline memberships only; not astrophysical classes and not scores.

capabilities.name: inspector
capabilities.reason: Delivered DiaSources and source-time broker snapshots of the sampled DiaObjects.
qualifications: Simple random sample of 5,000 of 3,487,175 DiaObjects (the lowest md5 of the decimal diaObjectId), with every delivered DiaSource of each. Sky density and per-date counts are complete; this layer is not, so it is never aggregated into population counts.

capabilities.name: lightcurve
capabilities.reason: Difference-image psfFlux of delivered DiaSources per band.
qualifications: No forced photometry or upper limits (Light Static).

capabilities.name: broker_inference
capabilities.reason: clf/pred/xm/lc_features as delivered with each DiaSource.
qualifications: Model scores are not calibrated probabilities.
fink_science_version changes within the cohort; scores from different versions are not strictly comparable.

capabilities.name: population
capabilities.reason: 5 of 9 registered dimensions are selectable; the rest are declared unavailable with reasons.

capabilities.name: population
capabilities.reason: 15 of 17 registered dimensions are selectable over the sampled DiaObjects; the rest are declared unavailable with reasons.
qualifications: Simple random sample of 5,000 of 3,487,175 DiaObjects (the lowest md5 of the decimal diaObjectId), with every delivered DiaSource of each. Sky density and per-date counts are complete; this layer is not, so it is never aggregated into population counts.

capabilities.name: cross_broker_association
capabilities.reason: Cross-broker association is a future versioned scientific relation product. No ANTARES locus is matched to any Fink DiaObject in this basis.

capabilities.name: side_by_side
capabilities.reason: Each domain is drawn on its own normalization over synchronized geometry.

capabilities.name: difference_map
capabilities.reason: Raw ANTARES-minus-Fink counts are not meaningful: different entity ontologies, selection functions, time scales and evidence classes.

capabilities.name: shared_axes
capabilities.reason: Only dimensions with an identical definition_id (kernel-derived Galactic/ecliptic latitude) may share axes across domains.

capabilities.name: shared_utc_date_axis
capabilities.reason: Lanes share UTC-date bins only. Each domain maps its own time scale to UTC dates; MJDs are never aligned across domains.
qualifications: ANTARES MJD is treated as UTC by the historical exporter; Fink midpointMjdTai is TAI.
